_note: Synthetic test data. These are not real fares and are never loaded into a
development or production database - the integration suite creates a
throwaway database, loads this fixture, asserts on it and drops the
database. The four price pairs are the ones specified verbatim in build
brief section 8; flight numbers, dates and brands are scaffolding chosen so
the rows are distinguishable under the dedup key.
The provenance value is LIVE_COLLECTED because provenance is the field
under test: the lineage traversal has to reach a HEADLINE observation, and
the C5 trigger correctly refuses to build one over SIMULATED_DEMO rows.
